On July 30, 2025, Elliot H. Stein, Jr. notified the Board of Directors of BellRing Brands, Inc. (the "Board") of his resignation from the Board, effective September 30, 2026.
On July 30, 2025, the Board approved the following changes to its lead independent director and committee assignments, effective immediately:
• Thomas P. Erickson was appointed to serve as lead independent director, replacing Mr. Stein;

• Shawn W. Conway was appointed to serve as Chair of the Compensation and Corporate Governance Committee, replacing Mr. Stein, who no longer serves on the Compensation and Corporate Governance Committee; and
• Jennifer Kuperman was appointed to serve as a member of the Executive Committee.
